title: Money Problems with Percentages: Discount, Commission, VAT and Simple Interest
seo_title: Grade 7 Discount, Commission, VAT and Interest Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Solve money problems involving percentages (e.g., discount, commission, sales tax, simple interest).
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 money worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: discounts, commission, 12% VAT, simple interest and multi-step problems with pesos. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Discount, commission, tax and interest are all a percent of an amount.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Discount = rate × original price. Sale price = original price − discount.
  • Commission = rate × total sales. It is money a salesperson earns.
  • VAT (value-added tax) in the Philippines is 12%. Price with VAT = price × 1.12.
  • Simple interest: I = Prt (principal × rate per year × number of years). Amount to pay back = P + I.

Examples

Example

₱2,400 bag, 25% off

0.25 × 2,400 = 600

2,400 − 600

Answer: ₱1,800

Example

₱10,000 at 5% for 3 years

10,000 × 0.05 × 3

Answer: ₱1,500 interest

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Giving the discountSubtract it to get the sale price.
12% as 1.212% = 0.12; with VAT, × 1.12.
One year of interestMultiply by the number of years.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 7 ask about money problems?
faq.a: Solve money problems involving percentages, such as discount, commission, sales tax, and simple interest.
Value-added tax, a 12% tax added to the price of many goods in the Philippines.

faq.q: What is the difference between simple and compound interest?
faq.a: Simple interest is always computed on the original principal.

faq.q: How is commission different from salary?
faq.a: Commission depends on sales; salary is fixed.
